title: W/S WIPER ACCESS DOOR CONTROL ASM.
summary: Windshield wiper access door control assembly (the linkage frame under the cowl that opens and closes the vacuum-operated wiper door / wiper cover panel), all models. The control frame [1] is bolted at both ends through rubber seals [19], shims [5] and reinforcements [6] with nuts [7], and at the center to reinforcement [10] at the plenum panel with shims [9]; the door brackets [14] attach to the linkage with screws [12]/[13]. The wiper door relay (vacuum actuator) [18] mounts at the fender skirt (View B). Door height is set with stop screw [4] and jam nut [3].

parts.name: CONTROL ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Wiper access door control assembly (linkage frame)

parts.name: RELAY ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Relay assembly – wiper door vacuum actuator (relay)

parts.name: SEAL
parts.name_expanded: Seal (rubber pad at control mounting points)

materials.where: at screw [12] where it enters the control linkage near bracket [14]

fastening.to: cowl/plenum structure at the RH end of the control
fastening.note: Two studs on the end of control frame [1] pass through shims [5], the cowl panel, seal [19] and reinforcement [6]; nuts [7] go on from the far side. The stud face is marked as a CONTROL point (filled-square symbol).

fastening.to: cowl/plenum structure at the LH end of the control
fastening.note: Same stack at the LH end: control studs through shims [5], seal [19] and reinforcement [6]; nuts not called out at this end.
Center mount: studs on the control frame pass through shim [9] into reinforcement [10]; View A shows [10] fitted over the plenum panel center (arrow A).

fastening.to: control frame mounting pad (right of center)
fastening.note: Screw [8] passes through seal [19] into the control mount behind it.
Screw [12] goes down into the linkage arm where door bracket [14] connects; sealer 73f at this screw.
Screw [13] goes into bracket [14] (door side of the linkage).

fastening.to: door stop at the RH end of the control
fastening.note: Stop screw [4] bears on the STOP; jam nut [3] locks it. Adjust [4] until the door is flush with the fender, then torque [3].
View B: screw asm [15] goes down through the mounting ear of relay [18] into the bracket at the skirt.
View B: plate [16] sits on the skirt with two holes lined up (dashed lines) with the relay bracket; rivet [17] is shown on the bracket.

notes: NOTE Adjust [4] until door is flush with fender. Torque [3].
